reconciliation_note: FY2026 bridges, all from the printed statement: Retail sales 704,800 less Cost of sales 326,230 equals Gross profit 378,570. The Revenue row follows this file existing convention and carries the printed Retail sales line; the top Revenue line in the filing is 954,480 and includes Other revenue of 249,680, which the panel has no label for, so Gross profit ties to the retail line only. Gross profit 378,570 plus Other revenue 249,680 less the printed Other expenses 559,350 less the net impairment on financial assets 4,349 less the net foreign exchange loss 6,972 equals the printed profit from operating activities of 57,579, stored as Operating Profit (EBIT); Operating expenses are therefore stored as 320,991 so that Gross profit less Operating expenses equals that same 57,579. Net finance costs are stored as 26,048, being the printed finance costs of 65,375 less the printed finance income of 39,327. Profit before tax 31,065 less Income tax 13,826 equals Profit for the year 17,239, of which 14,330 is attributable to owners of the parent and 2,909 to non-controlling interests; the Net Profit row stores 14,286, the profit attributable to ordinary and N ordinary shareholders after the preference dividend of 44 that the earnings per share note deducts, matching this file FY2025 column of 27,724. Earnings per share 59.20 cents basic, as printed.
